programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Dealers on a Mission"
programme.desc: Larry takes on an impossible mission: he’s been asked to find an item worn in space by Apollo 15 legend Al Worden. Torie searches for Russian space items for a museum in San Francisco and Cole goes on the hunt for an item from Apollo 13.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Money Trouble"
programme.desc: Larry gets the offer of a lifetime: a Soviet era space suit. Torie pays big for an Apollo 11 artefact but it’s not what it seems. Cole meets Apollo 7 legend Walt Cunningham.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Road America Fly Over"
programme.desc: The Wisconsin Air National Guard add a jet-powered punch to the end of the national anthem at a Nascar race at Road America.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Learning to Fly"
programme.desc: We hang out with Motley Crue's lead singer Vince Neil as he starts taking flight lessons!

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Dog Fight & Skytypers"
programme.desc: Taking to the skies to dogfight other aircraft in air combat & a formation team that besides performing with military precision actually types long-lasting messages in the sky.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Suing Our Way To Space"
programme.desc: Cowboy hat-wearing billionaires have reasons for their multi-billion dollar investment in space exploration but it’s hard to ignore how much money they stand to make.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "School of Whales"
programme.desc: Follow a family of sperm whales in the heart of the Indian Ocean. Alongside a team of scientists, who have witnessed their most intimate moments over the past 7 years, we will lift the veil on the largest-toothed predator on earth.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "Paris & Barcelona"
programme.desc: Bones introduce his trademark trickery to people in Paris and Barcelona, performing mind reading and an attempt to escape a straitjacket while breakdancing.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "London"
programme.desc: In this episode Bones is back in his home city, London where he stuns locals with his mind reading, card trickery and disappearing skills.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Night"
programme.desc: Bones is in Seoul, South Korea. He explores the city by night and performs a mixture of magic tricks, including a vanishing trick, coin tricks and card tricks.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Traditional"
programme.desc: In this episode Bones is in South Korea, where he visits Taekwondo group, the K Tigers, a tarot card reader and reveals the secret to the perfect card shuffle.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Youth"
programme.desc: This time Magical Bones is in Seoul. He goes to the B-Boy championships and also visits his friend Ji and performs a spectacular trick on a shirt.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Just Like Downtown"
programme.desc: Dave deals with a messy train, J.P. takes down a tree, Regional Crane lifts a huge wall, and Maxum Crane moves a couch to a high-rise.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Taking out the Trash"
programme.desc: Dave faces a tricky residential lift, J.P. races between last-minute jobs, and Brad and Nathan Moore help a family’s dream come true.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Bridging the Gap"
programme.desc: Nathan battles strong winds on a big roofing job, Dave handles an easy lift, J.P. moves a hot tub, and Dan faces confusion on a bridge build.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Special Delivery"
programme.desc: Regional Crane’s new machine hits a hydraulic snag. Dave uses his downtime for repairs, and Brad helps clear a stand of pine trees.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Combat Helicopters"
programme.desc: Ultimate Combat Helicopters offers a fascinating perspective on the technology used to create today’s most powerful combat helicopters.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Thrill Rides"
programme.desc: Explore the ultimate adrenaline rush – the world’s fastest and scariest thrill rides.

programme.title: The Ship Sinkers
programme.desc: What fate awaits ships that were once proud vessels at bay, but have now turned into floating junkyards? While one option is to cut them up for scrap, another alternative is to use them to bolster marine biodiversity by turning them into artificial reefs. The old naval ships are sunk to an underwater resting place by ship sinkers.

programme.title: Disruptive Behaviour
programme.desc: Reuben Christian travels to Istanbul to meet the innovators who are changing the city and discover how technology is disrupting the old order.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Minnesota Family Farmhouse"
programme.desc: A family in Minnesota hire a team of house truckers to move their historic farmstead closer to work to eliminate their daily commutes.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Million Dollar Mansion"
programme.desc: The Pilcher family in Saskatchewan call in a team of house truckers to haul their stunning mansion across rough fields and down narrow lanes to save it from being demolished.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Hawaii House Chop"
programme.desc: A team of house truckers in Hawaii move a stunning house to a new plot of land for an entrepreneur in Honolulu.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Runway Race"
programme.desc: A family in St Cloud, Minnesota call in a team of house movers to move a beautiful two-storey home, destined to be their son’s first home, to rescue it from the wrecking ball.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Saving Private Terry"
programme.desc: Terry gets to relive part of his military carrier by attempting the famous sniper shot from Saving Private Ryan, and Larry and Terry demonstrate how sniper technology has developed over the years and test some amazing sniper shots.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "The Last Crusade of Indiana Terry"
programme.sub-title: The Last Crusade of Indiana Terry
programme.desc: Terry channels his inner Dr. Jones and tests 1 scene from Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade containing 3 different tests, two of which they will need a tank for. The duo will travel down to Uvalde, TX to visit Drivetanks.com to see if a tank round will topple over a car, and if a 9mm round can travel through three Germans.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "Equalizing Terry"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry will test 3 scenes from Denzel Washington’s Equalizer films. Can Terry be as cool as Denzel and use propane tanks and a microwave to create an explosion, use a staple gun to take out the bad guy, or create a scenario where a flash bang will ignite a room full of baking flour?

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "Silencing Terry"
programme.desc: Terry wants to demonstrate how Hollywood has used different objects to silence a gunshot, and he and Larry will take to the range to see which one is the most qualified to act as a silencer. Terry also has a sit-down with Joey Zasa from Godfather 3 (Joe Mantegna) to discuss what he thinks of Hollywood’s adaptation of the silencer.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "Hyperloop"
programme.desc: Virgin Hyperloop is a train that runs inside a steel tunnel. This revolutionary new vehicle floats along the track using magnetic levitation and glides at airline speeds.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Alien Worlds"
programme.desc: A virtual scalpel dissects methane lakes and icy crusts to reveal hidden oceans and water-erupting volcanoes on distant moons.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Asteroids"
programme.desc: By stripping the crust and peeling back craters, CGI exposes the hidden minerals and refueling potential locked inside these asteroid worlds.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Black Holes"
programme.desc: Stripping away cosmic layers with CGI, this film reveals how black holes act as both destructive abysses and vital anchors for our galaxy.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Comets"
programme.desc: Peeling back the dusty coma via CGI, this film explores if icy comets brought water and life to Earth while tracking the threats they pose.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Mars"
programme.desc: Beneath the red dust, CGI peels away Martian volcanoes and ice to reveal a once-Earth-like world and the challenges of future human missions.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Rising Tides"
programme.desc: The next generation of Earth observation satellites are now in place maintaining the continuity of long-term climate data. Scientists are concerned the rate is increasing beyond expectations and glacier melting continues unabated.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Earths Evil Twin"
programme.desc: Venus once may have been as hospitable to life as Earth is now. Then something changed and Venus became shrouded in hot dense toxic clouds. There are now plans to send advanced probes to the surface of Venus and find out what happened to our twin.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Increasing Orbit"
programme.desc: The ISS is the workhorse of the international spacefaring community, but its days are numbered. Replacement space stations are on the drawing board. However, with commercial interests these stations will add tourism and manufacturing to the mix.
